# Customer Requirement Specification (CRS)
Subject: Stock Transfer Between Articles at SKU Level (Without Product Group Validation)
ISSUE ID: 379413

## Background / Current System Behavior
In the current WFX ERP design:
- Article creation is based on the Product Group.
- Stock movement or adjustment between articles is allowed only if both articles belong to the same Product Group and share the same Storage UOM.
- This functionality is known as Equivalent Adjustment.
- Transfers between articles from different Product Groups are restricted.
- Such adjustments are only allowed when there is an active requirement (indent/order) against the article.

## Client Business Requirement
The client has requested the ability to transfer complete stock between articles at SKU level, without validation on Product Group or other parameters.

They want to perform inter-article stock transfers purely based on SKU selection, even if:
- Articles belong to different Product Groups, or
- No requirement exists against the article.

This feature will support flexible stock reclassification and correction of physical stock, especially in scenarios where similar items are defined under different articles.

## Proposed Transaction Flow (Expected Process)
Step 1: Initiate Stock Transfer
- User opens the Stock Transfer / Adjustment screen.
- Select the “To Article” (article that will receive the stock).
- Enter the Quantity to be transferred.
- The Storage UOM auto-populates (non-editable).
- Enter or confirm the Price (manual entry allowed).
Step 2: Select Source Article
- Select the “From Article” (article from which stock will be reduced).
- The system displays available SKUs for that article with stock details.
- User selects the specific SKU(s) from which stock should be reduced.
Step 3: Stock Movement Validation
Before processing the transaction, the system will perform the following validations:

• Available Stock Check – Ensure sufficient stock is available for the selected SKU.
• Free Stock Validation – Stock must be free, i.e., not reserved, allocated, or linked to any indent, FPO, or FPPO.
• No Product Group Validation – The system should not check or restrict based on Product Group.
• No Requirement Dependency – Transaction should not require a linked order or indent.

Upon confirmation, the system should:
- Reduce stock from the selected “From Article / SKU.”
- Increase stock for the selected “To Article / SKU.”
Step 4: Transaction Recording
Each transfer must generate a unique transaction number for traceability. The transaction should capture:
- Transaction Date
- From Article / SKU
- To Article / SKU
- Quantity & UOM
- Price
- Transaction Type: Inter-Article Stock Transfer (No Validation)
- Performed By (User ID)
- Remarks (if applicable)

## Reporting Requirements
Enhance or create a Stock Transfer Report to track all SKU-level transfers. The report should include:
- Transaction No. & Date
- From Article / SKU
- To Article / SKU
- Quantity & UOM
- Price
- Product Group (both articles)
- User ID
- Remarks
- Transaction Type

## Expected System Changes

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 4 rows · columns: Area (text), Change Required (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Area]
| Area | Change Required | Description |
| Screen | Add new Stock Transfer Type | Introduce a transaction type for SKU-Level Stock Transfer (No Validation). |
| Validation Logic | Modify | Remove dependency on Product Group, Requirement, and Storage UOM. Add check for Free Stock. |
| Database | New Mapping Table | Store From Article → To Article transfer mapping with SKU details. |
| Report | Add / Enhance | Include new transaction type in Stock Movement Report. |

## Additional Notes
- Functionality to be controlled via User Role/Permission, restricting access to authorized users only.
- The system must ensure complete traceability of all stock transfers.
- The stock reversal/cancellation process should follow standard stock adjustment reversal flow.
- Only Free Stock should be eligible for transfer (no reservations or allocations).
- The functionality must support SKU-wise selection and transfer for accuracy.

## 7. Expected Outcome
After implementation, the system will allow SKU-level stock transfers between any two articles, regardless of Product Group, provided the stock is free and available. This enhancement will improve operational flexibility and warehouse accuracy while maintaining transaction-level auditability.
